svg.title: Same world. Opposite pasts. Different choices.
svg.desc: 14 subject pairs (28 subjects) from the completed v4 confirmation. Mean paired difference 0.71, 95% interval 0.29 to 1.14, above the 0.2 threshold; 7 pairs show no difference.
svg.text: Same world. Opposite pasts. Different choices.
Completed v4 confirmation: 14 subject pairs / 28 subjects. In each seeded world one subject lived through Bo being reliable, the other Ari.
After a restart, whom do they ask to work with at their first work opportunity?
Endpoint: partner balance of work requests at the first post-restart work opportunity
(+1 Ari, −1 Bo; 0 = no work, solo work, or balanced). Restart = same-process manager rebuild.
